Intersection where $\sin x=\cos x$; dividing by $\cos x$: $\tan x=1$, so $x=\dfrac\pi4$ for $0<x<\dfrac\pi2$.

Substitute into $y=\sin x$: $y=\sin\dfrac\pi4=\dfrac1{\sqrt2}$, so $A\left(\dfrac\pi4,\dfrac1{\sqrt2}\right)$.

For $B$: $\tan x=1$ with $\pi<x<\dfrac{3\pi}2$, so $x=\dfrac{5\pi}4$.

$A=\displaystyle\int_{\pi/4}^{5\pi/4}(\sin x-\cos x)\,dx=\Big[-\cos x-\sin x\Big]_{\pi/4}^{5\pi/4}=-\Big[\cos x+\sin x\Big]_{\pi/4}^{5\pi/4}$

$=-\left(-\dfrac1{\sqrt2}-\dfrac1{\sqrt2}-\left(\dfrac1{\sqrt2}+\dfrac1{\sqrt2}\right)\right)=2\sqrt2\ \text{u}^2$

For $1\le x\le4$: $F(x)=\dfrac1{12}\displaystyle\int_1^x\left(t^2-2t+2\right)dt=\dfrac1{12}\left[\dfrac{x^3}3-x^2+2x-\dfrac43\right]=\dfrac{x^3}{36}-\dfrac{x^2}{12}+\dfrac x6-\dfrac19$

$$F(x)=\begin{cases}0 & x<1\\ \dfrac{x^3}{36}-\dfrac{x^2}{12}+\dfrac x6-\dfrac19 & 1\le x\le4\\ 1 & x>4\end{cases}$$

notes: Cover instructions say Section II is Questions 11-32; 22 printed questions. Q16 and Q29 each group two unrelated items so are stored as 16(a),16(b),29(a),29(b) (34 records). Q22 part b has no marks of its own (stem for i, ii), stored with marks null. Solutions bundled in separate file 1276 (handwritten guidelines in red). Guideline errors/oddities: Q23(a) guideline writes domain as (3,infinity) with round bracket; correct is [3,infinity) and is stored so. Q30(a) guideline gives x=52.79 then answer $60 although nearest $10 would be $50 (kept as printed; teacher likely rounded up) - check. Q17(a) guideline working '(5x6)+(6+8)' is garbled; stored as 6x6+4x2+quarter circle+triangle, same final answer 46+4pi. Q4 and Q30 and Q31 flagged as Standard-course content. Paper print typos: Q1-Q10 MCQ answers in red circles on solutions file. Figures for Q12 blank answer axes, Q20(c) blank axes not cropped (answer space). Page indexes are 0-based (cover is index 0).
